kv5.label: Kromayer and Veith, Schlachten-Atlas (1922-29), Griech. Abt. Bl. 1, map 5: Thermopylen 1:100,000
kv5.note: Seven village/monastery points fit at <260 m. Dropped (leave-one-out 0.8-2.7 km): Frantzis, Kostalexis, Dyovouna, Eleftherochori, Ano Damasta, Mendenitsa, Irakleia -- villages relocated since c.1900 (e.g. Kromayer's Paleo-/Elevtherochori, Neu-/Alt-Damasta) or ancient sites (Herakleia) not the modern village.
